slides.texte_overlay:
habits that make you
quietly self assured

keeping eye contact

hold eye contact for one extra second when you greet someone. it feels small, but it tells people you're comfortable being seen, and you start to believe it.

eating alone in public

have lunch alone at a café once a week without your phone. enjoying your own company in public is one of the quickest ways to stop caring what people think.

taking up space

sit back in your chair and let your shoulders relax instead of folding in. your body tells your mind how safe you feel, so open posture slowly builds real confidence.

growing a little daily

spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a planet, a painting, a myth. knowing you grow a little every day gives you a calm and very steady kind of inner confidence.

finishing what you start

finish the small things you start, even a book or a short walk. every finished task quietly proves to you that you're someone who always follows through.
